dimensions.explanation: Wood + Wood. Same element 80, a generating pair 85, other pairs 60. Auto uses the civil birth date's day stem at noon, without true-solar-time correction; it is not a full Ba Zi chart or Xi/Yong Shen.

dimensions.title: Personality lens
dimensions.explanation: Optional self-reported four-letter type; no type is an ideal partner. Similarity index: 60 + 5 per shared letter. Unknown types are excluded, not penalized.
dimensions.prompt: What do people often misunderstand about how you recharge or decide?
